new_results: Uniform capped descent: for V>=40 and E8=H8(V)+R with 0<=R<C(V-18,2), the residual disappears by rank 6 and E5=F5+8.
One-sided sufficient barrier E8<=H8(V)+C(V-18,2)-1 implies E5<=F5+8.
Exact Galois thresholds: L6>=V+5 iff G7>=C(V-5,2)+10, and L7>=c+9 iff G8>=C(c+1,2)+8V-100.
Only the top 17 residual integers in the cap need positive L8 for the rank-6 propagation; the associated G9 threshold is at most 17V-476.
At the cap endpoint, self-propagation of the rank-8 barrier requires L8>=V+1 and a quadratic G9 threshold, refuting the nonquantitative positive-gap route.
